report:
I graded all 5 windows for `l2-chained_turn_person-v9-p4`: four 0s and one 1. All are stored in `annotations/labels/judgment/l2-chained_turn_person-v9-p4.jsonl`. Two were first rejected because some refs fell outside their windows' time range; I dropped those refs and resubmitted, and both were accepted.

**Episodes in Thompson_Thompson_100.** The whole stretch is a dense crowd at a tailgate (a pre-game party), and there is only one front camera.

| Window | Grade | What happens |
|---|---|---|
| 0212 | **1** | Closest match. The robot's heading swings right from 205 s: −30° by 210 s, −80° by 211.5 s. A man in a black "TEXAS" shirt first appears at 210.0 s (frame #6246; he's not in #6231 at 209.5 s). Speed drops from 1.0 to 0.25 m/s at 210.9 s. Lidar clearance in the path has a local minimum of ~1.8 m at ~211.3 s. Speed is back to ≥0.9 m/s by ~211.7 s with him still in view. |
| 0124 | 0 | Left turn of +35° at 120.5–122 s, but no slowdown of 30% or more follows; the biggest dip is ~28%. |
| 0148 | 0 | Slowdown from 1.03 to 0.67 m/s at 144.9 s while following the same group. Nobody new appears, the heading only drifts ~25° beforehand, and clearance stays flat. |
| 0184 | 0 | Slowdown from 1.50 to 0.49 m/s at 182.2 s comes before the −32° turn at 182.8–183.5 s, so the order is wrong. |
| 0224 | 0 | The window holds a −45° turn at 219–221 s. The next slowdown (1.0 to 0.35 m/s at 226.8 s) is ~6 s later, and the orange-shirt man next to it is out of view by 228.0 s (#6786). That's before speed gets back to 90% at ~229.1 s. |

0212 gets 1 rather than 2 for two reasons:
- **Turn overlaps the slowdown:** the sharp part of the turn (209.5–211.5 s) happens during the slowdown, not before it.
- **Crowd throughout:** with people always in view, "a person becomes visible only after a turn" can't be established.

This matches how earlier labellers graded the crowd episodes in Butler, Sanjac and Library_MLK.

**Grade counts:** 2 → 0, 1 → 1, 0 → 4, −1 → 0.

**What the data can't establish (for the `answered_partial` analysis):**
- **Person newness in crowds.** "Visible only after a turn" can't be shown when people are in view the whole time.
- **Which person counts.** With many people in view, "before the person disappears from every camera view" depends on which person you pick. With one camera it amounts to "leaves the front view".
- **"Earliest event across recordings."** This is a ranking across recordings and can't be judged one window at a time, so I ignored it, as the earlier labellers did.
